text: Next week, everyone uploads the same GTA 6 gameplay. The thumbnail decides who gets clicked.
Most creators spend an hour on it. Mine takes thirty seconds, with AI.
Grab one frame from your clip: the chase, the crash, the close call.
One prompt turns it into a thumbnail: two bold words, neon sunset glow.
Then ask AI for ten titles, and keep the one with what people search, like GTA 6 police chase.
And put the hook on screen in the first second.
Comment KIT and I'll send you every prompt, the title formulas and ten hooks.
